original_objective: Complete the remaining Phase 2 gate measurements and subsequent FoveaTag work.
owner_requested_extension: Pause the current experiment, integrate run monitoring and SigLIP2 training-option coverage, verify it through the frontend, then resume the same run.
scope: Preserve the accepted Phase 2 artifact and the complete downstream Phase 3/4/5 objectives.
Register the existing A/B/C experiment in the normal training-run catalog without fabricating a SigLIP2 run.
Display branch, epoch, step, progress, loss, validation precision/recall/F1, learning rate and checkpoint/resume state.
Connect start/resume/stop to checkpointed lifecycle controls and enforce GPU ownership and duplicate-run guards.
Audit every TAGGER_TRAINING_DEFAULTS and request/UI option: shared, architecture-specific, implemented, or remaining; no silent option dropping.
Implement applicable optimizer, loss, learning-rate groups, precision, attention and checkpointing controls.
Implement applicable dataset, vocabulary, masking, online collection, vocabulary growth, detailed metrics, retention, sample and export integrations.
Keep pretrained SigLIP2 initialization options out of the scratch FoveaTag default and explain incompatible architecture-specific options.
Preserve the registered A/B/C input/data/optimizer budget when resuming the current experiment; new optional controls must not change its contract.
Update API defaults, OpenAPI, request types and UI together; test backend compilation, real imports and lifecycle contracts; review frontend statically.
Deploy only task-scoped changes to the running checkout, use only the backend restart endpoint if needed, then verify real API and frontend operation.
Resume the paused experiment only after the requested integration is verified.

pause.note: The legacy detached CLI lacks an external graceful-stop control. Its verified checkpoint is retained; unsaved subsequent steps will be replayed on resume.

reporting_policy: Aggregate metrics only; do not display individual tag names or read generated diagnostic images.
